channel.title: The Grant Desk - AI, Tech & Research, Africa, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: AI, Tech & Research, Africa, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily.

item.title: 2 new AI, Tech & Research grants - week of 08 Jun 2026
item.description:
• ARUA: Early-Career Research Fellowships 2026 (Option 2)
    https://arua.org/early-career-research-fellowships/
    African Research Universities Alliance (ARUA), with the Mastercard Foundation and Carnegie Corporation of New York · deadline Closed 15 Jul 2026 · Monthly stipend of USD 2,000, a modest accommodation payment, and travel support (return ticket to host institution). 6-month fellowship.
  • Cambridge-Africa: ALBORADA Research Fund 2026
    https://www.cambridge-africa.cam.ac.uk/initiatives/2026-call-for-applications
    Cambridge-Africa Programme, University of Cambridge (supported by The ALBORADA Trust) · deadline 03 Sep 2026 · Competitive grants of GBP 1,000 to 25,000. Covers research costs such as reagents, fieldwork, equipment and research-training activities in Africa (e.g. setting up courses/workshops). No application fee.
